question: What bodily rejuvenation and freedom from disease result from this contemplative configuration?
premises: The practitioner becomes free from wrinkles and grey hair.
The practitioner becomes devoid of all diseases.
These are presented as results of the practice.
inference: This contemplation makes one free from wrinkles, grey hair, and all diseases.
uncertainties: The two compounds differ in case ending as given, though they appear to describe the same result.
plain_english: One becomes freed from wrinkles and grey hair, and devoid of all diseases.
